topics.description: Minnesota and Indiana are reopening child care assistance programs for low-income families. This comes as a $200 million boost is given to Indiana's program.
topics.reason: New developments in child care assistance

topics.description: Despite progress with federal agencies, significant Medicaid cuts loom in Minnesota. This could impact thousands of residents.
A 'phantom billing' fraud scheme targets Medicare recipients and Minnesota taxpayers. This results in millions of dollars in losses.
